quests.title: Promises Remembered as Lanterns Rise

dialogue.t: I have to hurry...
No. But it's the Lantern Rite now. Lots of people have headed back to the city to spend the festive period there, so we're short-staffed. I'm basically doing everything myself.
We're not getting too many guests, though, so things aren't too bad. I can still handle it.
*cough* Also, I should thank you for helping me previously. If it hadn't been for your help, I don't think I'd ever have been able to return to work...
N—No! Definitely not, believe me! I—If she were to show up again, I d—don't know if my heart could take it...
If you really want to ask about... her... you should just go ask the boss. I—I don't know anything, I swear...
If you really want to ask about... her... you should just go ask the boss. I—I don't know anything, I swear...
Traveler! How can I help?
Oh, her? She's been quite well-behaved since that incident.

But I do feel bad for that child. Whenever a festive period rolled along in the past, she'd get lonelier as the inn grew livelier. As a result, she would wind up starting trouble and scaring the guests.
But I'm sure that she just wants someone to play with her. She is only a child, after all.

dialogue.sit: Can we send her a Xiao Lantern?
I wonder if she'd like a Xiao Lantern...

dialogue.t: You want to send her a Xiao Lantern? That's not a bad idea. The only trouble is that she's quite hard to find...
If you're looking for her, you should hang a Xiao Lantern atop one of the trees in the nearby forest at night.
That way, she should be able to see it.
If you're looking for her, you should hang a Xiao Lantern atop one of the trees in the nearby forest.
That way, she should be able to see it.
This should be the place. Wonder where she is...
Oh, you're back. You're here to play with me!
Hehe, did you remember what I said last time?
Well then, let's play... hide and seek.
Well, did you deliver the Xiao Lantern?

dialogue.sit: I guess... we can consider it sent.

dialogue.t: I believe so, too. This should cheer her up a bit at least.
I wonder, what sort of wish would that child make?

quests.description: Wangshu Inn’s chef, Smiley Yanxiao, seems to have a lot on his plate right now…
